scope: Miao Chapter 17 (pp. 559-586): the Aiyagari production economy (the income fluctuation problem, Definition 17.1.1, existence of stationary equilibrium, r below the rate of time preference, overaccumulation), the Huggett, Bewley and fiat-money endowment economies (Definition 17.2.1, Propositions 17.2.1-17.2.3, interest on currency, seigniorage), recursive equilibrium with aggregate shocks (Definition 17.3.1) and the Krusell-Smith method, and Exercises 4-6.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 17
